high_level_description: This is a black-and-white photograph of a person standing in shallow water near the shore of a body of water, possibly a lake or sea. The individual is wearing a sleeveless top and high-waisted pants, with their hands resting by their sides. They have short hair and appear to be looking directly at the camera. In the background, there is a serene landscape featuring a cloudy sky and distant hills or mountains. A swan is swimming in the water behind the person, adding a touch of natural beauty to the scene. The overall setting suggests a peaceful and tranquil environment.
